profile.label: Phố nhà phố về đêm / City shophouse street at night (ban đêm / night)
profile.description: Phố nhà phố về đêm, ban đêm. Wide city street at night: row of 2-3 storey shophouses with colored ground-floor sign bands in English (CAFE, HOTEL, PHARMACY, NOODLES, BARBER, CLOTHES, GOLD, MINIMART, MASSAGE), vertical HOTEL blade sign, balconies, AC units, lit and dark windows, striped awnings, two shops shuttered; elevated expressway with car lights behind the roofs, rooftop billboards with glowing rings, distant towers; tiled sidewalk with parked scooters and street lamps, asphalt road with lane dashes and sign reflections. Rain variant: heavy rain streaks, puddles, stronger wet reflections (night). phố, nhà phố, biển hiệu, đường trên cao, xe máy, mưa, city street, shophouses, neon signs, elevated road, rain, ban đêm, night
